screenshot.description: Stateless: capture a PNG of a URL in a fresh browser context. PREFERRED: pass task_id (your $TASK_ID) — the FULL-RESOLUTION PNG is uploaded straight to the task as an attachment and you get back only its id. This is how you deliver visual evidence: never re-encode a screenshot to base64 yourself and never downscale it. Optional: instance_id + agent_type persists to the run dir (lost under Kubernetes); inline returns base64 (huge, unreliable — avoid).

params.task_id: Your $TASK_ID env var — uploads the full-res PNG to the task directly (preferred delivery).
params.filename: Label for the attachment (a .png extension is added if missing).
params.instance_id: Optional run-dir persistence: your $INSTANCE_ID env var
params.agent_type: Optional run-dir persistence: your $AGENT_NAME env var
params.inline: Also return base64 inline (avoid — large and unreliable).

get_text.description: Stateless: open a URL and return the visible text (post-JS render). Use browser_get_text instead when you have an active session.

browser_new_session.description: Create a persistent browser session (isolated BrowserContext). Returns a session_id — pass it to all browser_* tools. Pass instance_id + agent_type to enable screenshot/video persistence and script name resolution. Set record_video=true to record the full session as a .webm — the file is saved when you call browser_close_session. For evidence a person will watch, use evidence_start instead: it films only the actions, with cursor and subtitles. For mobile/9:16 recordings use viewport_width=390 viewport_height=844. Sessions expire after 10 min of inactivity.

params.task_id: Your $TASK_ID — every browser_screenshot in this session then uploads its full-res PNG to the task automatically (preferred delivery).
params.instance_id: Your $INSTANCE_ID env var (optional run-dir persistence + script resolution)
params.record_video: Record the session as a .webm video. File is saved on close.

browser_close_session.description: Close a browser session and free its resources. Always call this when done. If the session was started with record_video=true, the .webm is finalized and saved to the agent's output dir. A take still recording on it is discarded.

browser_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL within the session. Returns the final URL and page title.

params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_get_state.description: Return all interactive elements on the current page as a numbered list. Each element shows its index, tag, attributes, placeholder, value, and visible text. Use the index number with browser_click, browser_type, browser_select, browser_hover. Call this after every navigation or interaction that changes the DOM.

browser_get_text.description: Return the visible text content of the current page (post-JS render).

browser_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of the current session page. PREFERRED: pass task_id (or create the session with task_id) — the FULL-RESOLUTION PNG is uploaded straight to the task and you get back only its id. Never re-encode or downscale a screenshot yourself. Optional: a session created with instance_id + agent_type persists to the run dir (lost under Kubernetes); inline returns base64 (avoid).

params.task_id: Your $TASK_ID — uploads the full-res PNG to the task directly (preferred). Defaults to the session's task_id if set at creation.
params.filename: Label for the attachment (a .png extension is added if missing).
params.inline: Force inline base64 return (avoid — large and unreliable).

browser_click.description: Click an element. Use the index from browser_get_state, or pass a CSS selector. Returns the URL after click (may have navigated).

params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_type.description: Type text into an input or textarea. Clears the field first by default. Use the index from browser_get_state, or pass a CSS selector.

params.text: What to type. Can be left out when `secret` names a test login of a recording chat: the value is then fetched from Thulu and typed without anyone seeing it.
params.secret: Name of what `text` is (e.g. "password") when it must not be shown or stored: it is left out of the log and the reply, typed as dots on camera, and a take keeps only the name. In a recording chat, pass only secret="NAME" (a test login name from evidence_recording) and no text: the value comes from Thulu.
params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_select.description: Select an option in a <select> element. Use the index from browser_get_state, or pass a CSS selector. Pass the option value or visible label as 'value'.

params.value: Option value or visible label to select
params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.
During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_hover.description: Hover over an element to trigger hover-only UI (dropdowns, tooltips, menus). Use the index from browser_get_state, or pass a CSS selector. Follow with browser_get_state to see newly revealed elements.

params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_press_key.description: Simulate a keyboard key press. Common keys: Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Backspace.

params.key: Key name (e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown)
params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_run_script.description: Execute a Playwright script in the current session. For evidence of a flow, prefer evidence_start (live) or evidence_render (a JSON take): they film, verify and report without code. Three modes: (1) name: load script by filename from the agent's scripts/browser/ directory (requires agent_type in session). (2) path: absolute path inside the container to a .js file (must be under /agents-shared). (3) code: inline JS string executed as an async function body, receiving (page, params). Scripts can return a value (serialized as JSON). Module-style scripts (with 'export default') are supported.

params.name: Script filename (without .js) from agent's scripts/browser/ dir
params.path: Absolute container path to script file (must be under /agents-shared)
params.code: Inline JS code (async function body, has access to page and params). Prefer a take.
params.params: Parameters passed to the script as second argument

browser_list_scripts.description: List available Playwright scripts in a directory. If session_id is provided and the session has an agent_type, auto-resolves to that agent's scripts/browser/ dir. Pass dir to override.

params.dir: Absolute container path to scripts directory (auto-resolved from session if omitted)

browser_wait.description: Wait for a fixed number of milliseconds. Useful in recorded sessions to add deliberate pauses — letting the camera linger on a screen, or waiting for animations to finish before the next interaction. Max 10 000 ms per call.

params.label: During a take (evidence_start): what this step shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle and chapter.

browser_get_session_log.description: Return the full interaction log for a session as JSON. Each entry has: t (timestamp), tool, args, and elementInfo (selector/tag captured at interaction time).

browser_export_script.description: Generate a reusable Playwright script from the session's interaction log. Outputs a module-style .js file with an exported async function. If path is provided, saves the file there (must be under /agents-shared). Otherwise returns the code inline. Elements clicked/typed on are exported using their captured CSS selectors. Review and fix any TODO comments in the output before using as a script.

params.path: Absolute container path to save the script (must be under /agents-shared)
params.description: Human-readable description added as a comment to the script

evidence_start.description: Start recording a take on a browser session. From now on every browser_navigate/click/type/select/hover/press_key/scroll/wait on this session is filmed with a cursor, a highlight ring and a subtitle (pass `label` to each call), and written into the take with a stable selector. Only the actions are filmed: your thinking time between calls is cut. Set changes_data=true when the flow creates or modifies data, so the take is never replayed by accident.

params.title: What the take proves, e.g. "SHOP-142 · checkout keeps the coupon"
params.base_url: Origin the take replays against. Default: the current page's origin.
params.redact_css: CSS selectors blurred on every frame (emails, tokens, names).

evidence_shot.description: Annotated capture of the current page: spotlight with numbered notes, dimmed surroundings, redaction boxes, and a header with host and time. Inside a take it also appears in the video and is published with it. Outside a take it is uploaded to the task right away (task_id, or the session's). At most 3–4 spots: more is two captures.

params.name: Short file name, e.g. "coupon-applied"
params.title: Header line: what the capture shows
params.spotlight: Zones to highlight, numbered in order. tone: focus (default), ok, warn, bad.
params.notes: Footnotes: context not visible on screen
params.redact: Elements covered with an opaque block
params.dim: Dim outside the spotlight (default: true when there is a spotlight)
params.keep_clean: Also deliver the capture without annotations
params.wait_ms: How long to wait for each spot. 0 when its absence is the finding.
params.task_id: Outside a take: the task to attach to (default: the session's)

evidence_verify.description: Record a verification: a test case, what was expected and what the page shows. Prefer `check` (visible, hidden, text, value, count, url, title) with a target: the engine measures it now and again on every replay, polling until it matches or times out. `observed` is for what only you can judge. Inside a take a pass/fail card appears in the video.

params.case: Case id as the ticket names it, e.g. "TC-3"
params.expected: Expected value. For visible/hidden checks: "visible" or "hidden".
params.observed: What you observed, when there is no check to measure it
params.timeout_ms: How long a check may poll (default 5000)

evidence_note.description: Say something in the video: a subtitle held on screen with a progress bar. level=fact or issue also lists it in the report (issue = a finding). Requires a take.

evidence_finish.description: Stop recording and render the take into a draft: an MP4 without dead time, and a contact sheet you get back as an image. Returns render_id (for evidence_publish) and take_id (the take as JSON, replayable with evidence_render). Nothing reaches the task until evidence_publish. discard=true throws the take away.

evidence_get_take.description: Return a take as JSON, to edit it (labels, beats, checks) or save it in the repo under .octopus/evidence/takes/.

evidence_render.description: Replay a take in a clean browser and render it into a draft (MP4 + contact sheet image). The take is JSON: inline in `take` (e.g. read from the repo's .octopus/evidence/takes/) or a take_id. `library` carries the repo's targets.json and flows (@name targets, {kind:"use"} flows). Secrets for fill steps go in `secrets` and never enter the take. compare_base_url runs the same take against a second origin and renders both side by side, step by step (before/after). Refuses takes marked as changing data unless allow_side_effects. Nothing reaches the task until evidence_publish.

params.take: The take JSON (version, title, base_url, viewport, steps)
params.secrets: name → value, for fill steps with `secret`
params.base_url: Replay against this origin instead of the take's
params.compare_base_url: Second origin for a side-by-side before/after
params.labels: Badges for the two sides (default Before, After)
params.task_id: Task the render will be published to (can also be given to evidence_publish)

evidence_recording.description: In a recording chat (Evidence library): the case to record (title, steps, expected result), the environment to record it on (name, base URL) and the names of its test logins. Call it first. Outside a recording chat it says so.

evidence_save_case.description: In a recording chat: save a take as the case's recording in the Evidence library. Give exactly one of take_id (from evidence_finish), render_id or take. The take is checked first (it must replay with no repo library: no flows, no @targets). Thulu then queues a first run of the case on the recording's environment, so the person sees the replay pass or fail without asking.

params.take_id: The take_id evidence_finish or evidence_render returned
params.render_id: A render whose take to save
params.take: The take as JSON, when you corrected it by hand
params.title: Replaces the take's title

evidence_publish.description: Deliver a render to its task: the video, captures, chapters and take are uploaded server to server, and a report that embeds them (results table, findings, captures, chapters) is posted to the task's Reports tab. Every verdict whose case is a test case key of the task (TC-1) is recorded as a run of that case, with the video, take, captures and report; several verdicts of one case make one run (fail if any failed, blocked if a failed step kept one from running, else pass); in a before/after the after side is recorded. Do not also record these runs with task_test_case_run. record_runs=false skips it.

params.task_id: Default: the task the session or render was started for
params.record_runs: Record the verdicts as runs of the task's test cases

params.label: What this shows, in the ticket's words. Subtitle in the video and chapter in the report.
params.take_target: Playwright selector, or @name from the target library

errors.scroll_direction: direction must be one of: down, up, top, bottom
errors.no_agent_type: Session has no agent_type — pass path instead of name, or create session with agent_type
errors.dir_required: dir required, or create session with agent_type for auto-resolution
errors.tool_not_allowed: Tool '{name}' is not in the allowed list for this session
errors.step_not_playable: step kind "{kind}" cannot be played (flows are compiled before playing)
errors.take_does_not_compile: the take does not compile against the library
errors.base_url_required: base_url is required when the session has not navigated to a web page yet
errors.take_changes_data: the take changes data and replaying it would change it again
errors.take_changes_data_hint: use the live recording (evidence_finish) for this flow, or pass allow_side_effects if the environment can take it
errors.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed in this browser image
errors.fill_value_and_secret: fill takes value or secret, not both
errors.verify_needs_observed: verify needs observed, or check to measure it
errors.no_unique_selector: could not describe <{tag}> with a selector that matches only it
errors.no_element_at: No element at index {index} (page has {count} interactive elements)
errors.no_credential: no Thulu credential was forwarded with this call — the agent's key rides on the MCP handshake (X-API-Key); this server holds none of its own
errors.no_take_recording: no take is recording on this session — call evidence_start first
errors.take_already_recording: a take ("{title}") is already recording on this session — finish or discard it first
errors.shot_needs_task: outside a take a capture is uploaded to a task: pass task_id
errors.handshake_no_key: an MCP session needs the run's key on the handshake (X-API-Key or Authorization: Bearer)
errors.message_key_mismatch: this message does not carry the key its session was opened with
errors.list_only_session: this session was opened without a credential: it can list tools, not call them
errors.handshake_wrong_run_key: this browser belongs to one run and only accepts that run's key (X-API-Key)
errors.handshake_catalog_only: this server only lists its tools: each run has its own thulu-browser (MCP_CATALOG_ONLY)
errors.secret_unreadable: Thulu answered the test login "{name}" with something that is not a value
errors.not_recording_chat: there is no open recording in this chat: evidence_recording and evidence_save_case work only in the chat Thulu opens to record an Evidence case (Evidence → a case → Record with agent), until its take is saved
errors.save_one_take: give exactly one of take_id, render_id or take
errors.render_has_no_take: render {id} has no take to save (nothing was recorded between evidence_start and evidence_finish)
errors.type_needs_text: browser_type needs text, or secret alone in a recording chat
errors.secret_not_available: no test login named "{name}" is available here: without text, secret works only in a recording chat and only with a name its environment has (evidence_recording lists them). Outside one, pass text together with secret
errors.job_bad_next: the daemon answered the next run without a run id

text.attached: Attached full-resolution to task {task} as "{file}" (id {id}, {bytes} bytes). No downscaling.
text.attach_failed: WARNING: direct attach failed ({err}). Falling back to persist/inline.
text.saved: Saved to {path} — will be auto-attached to the task on run exit.
text.persist_failed: WARNING: could not persist ({err}). Returning inline.
text.session_recording: Recording: enabled — video will be saved on browser_close_session.
text.session_usage:
Pass this session_id to all browser_* tools.
Sessions expire after {minutes} min of inactivity.
text.session_gone: Session '{id}' not found (may have already expired).
text.video_missing: WARNING: recording enabled but no .webm found after close.
text.take_unfinished: The take "{title}" was never finished and was discarded.
text.export_todo_click: // TODO: browser_click — no stable selector captured (index was {index})
text.export_todo_type: // TODO: browser_type — no stable selector (index was {index}, text="{text}")
text.export_todo_select: // TODO: browser_select — no stable selector (index was {index}, value="{value}")
text.render_no_video: No video: nothing was filmed (no step reached the screen).
text.render_shot_crowded: Capture "{name}": too crowded, its notes cover a highlighted element. Split it into shots with fewer spotlights or shorter notes.
text.render_next_steps:
Check the contact sheet below. If it reads well, call evidence_publish with this render_id;
otherwise fix the take (labels, targets, beats) and render again. Nothing reached the task yet.
text.report_observed_note: ¹ Observed by the agent, not measured by the replay.
text.cases_unknown: Not test cases on this task: {keys}
text.cases_error: Could not record the test case runs: {error}. The files and the report are on the task; record the missing runs with task_test_case_run and report_id={report}.
text.recording_started:
Recording "{title}" against {url}.
Every browser_* action on this session is filmed and written down; pass `label` to each one. End with evidence_finish.
text.shot_crowded: Too crowded: its notes cover a highlighted element. Split it into shots with fewer spotlights or shorter notes.
text.shot_recorded: Capture "{name}" recorded in the take; it is published with it.
text.report_posted: Report posted to the Reports tab ({id}).
text.recording_logins: Test logins: {names}. Type one with browser_type(secret="NAME") and no text; never ask the person for it.
text.recording_no_logins: This environment has no test logins.
text.recording_next: Next: browser_new_session, browser_navigate to the base URL, evidence_start, the flow with a label per step, evidence_verify with check + target, evidence_finish, evidence_save_case.
text.case_saved_queued: Saved as {key}'s recording; a first run on {env} is queued (batch {batch}).
text.case_saved_changes_data: The take changes data, so it will not replay automatically: that first run will end in error. Say so to the person.
text.case_saved_no_checks: The take has no checks: a replay can only tell whether its steps ran.
text.case_saved_observed_only: Some checks are observed, not measured (no check + target): replays copy what you saw instead of measuring it.

log.listening: thulu-browser v{version} MCP server listening on {host}:{port}
log.mode_per_run: Mode:              per run (only this run's key)
log.mode_catalog_only: Mode:              catalog only (lists tools, runs none)
log.job_env_missing: evidence runner: OCTOPUS_API, OCTOPUS_API_KEY and EVIDENCE_BATCH_ID are required
log.job_retry: evidence runner: {method} {route} failed ({error}); retrying in {ms} ms
log.job_run_done: evidence runner: run {run} finished: {status} in {ms} ms
log.job_result_refused: evidence runner: the daemon refused the result of run {run}: {error}
log.job_done: evidence runner: batch {batch} has nothing left
log.job_unreachable: evidence runner: {url} never answered ({error}); the batch closes as an environment failure
log.host_gateway: Host loopback:     {host} (sessions of runs on a runner)
log.host_loopback_unconfigured: [session] a run on a runner asked for the host's localhost, but HOST_GATEWAY is not set: its pages open this container's localhost
